name: Doushen (Beijing) Education & Technology INC.
summary: Doushen (Beijing) Education & Technology INC. provides education, software, and information technology services in China. It offers art learning, live-streaming e-commerce, cultural tourism and study tours, smart education, and artificial intelligence education services. The company was formerly known as Beijing Lanxum Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Doushen (Beijing) Education & Technology INC. in August 2020. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Beijing, China.
